news.title: Financial Commentary Highlights Growth and Backlog
news.text: Yahoo Finance noted AeroVironment's strong Q4 segment revenue growth, robust order backlog, and fiscal 2026 guidance supported by the BlueHalo acquisition.

news.title: Chair Wahid Nawabi Sells 17,300 Shares
news.text: Insider selling disclosure showed Chair Wahid Nawabi sold 17,300 shares for roughly $4.55 million, equal to about 12.4% of his holdings.

news.title: Skyfall Mars Helicopter Mission Concept Unveiled
news.text: AeroVironment and NASA's JPL introduced the Skyfall concept featuring six scout helicopters to support future Mars missions, targeting a 2028 launch.

news.title: RBC Capital Lifts Price Target to $300
news.text: RBC Capital raised its AeroVironment price target to $300 and reiterated an Outperform rating following management meetings.

news.title: Golden Dome Partnership Announced with SNC
news.text: AeroVironment and SNC publicized a partnership to deliver the Golden Dome solution supporting America's Limited Area Defense architecture.

news.title: Initial P550 Autonomous Systems Delivered to U.S. Army
news.text: The company delivered its first P550 autonomous Group 2 eVTOL unmanned aircraft systems to the U.S. Army for the LRR program.

news.title: Analyst Coverage Expands with New Strong Buy Ratings
news.text: Needham and Canaccord Genuity initiated coverage with Strong Buy ratings and $300+ price targets, reinforcing a bullish analyst consensus.

news.title: Shares Surge 30.5% on Earnings and Outlook
news.text: AeroVironment's stock jumped 30.5% in September after record results and raised EPS guidance signaled continued growth momentum.

news.title: Record Revenue and Backlog Highlight Growth Drivers
news.text: CEO Wahid Nawabi emphasized record revenue and backlog across Autonomous Systems and Space, Cyber, and Directed Energy segments while increasing EPS guidance.

news.title: Raymond James and BofA Boost Price Targets
news.text: Raymond James lifted its target to $348 and Bank of America initiated coverage at $300, citing strong growth opportunities for AeroVironment.

news.title: UK Expansion and Tomahawk Grip Agreement
news.text: The company opened a Hereford office and entered a coproduction deal with TIA for the Tomahawk Grip controller to expand UK operations.

news.title: Switchblade 600 Air Launch Demonstrated
news.text: AeroVironment completed the first air launch of a Switchblade 600 loitering munition from an MQ-9A Reaper UAS, highlighting deployment flexibility.

news.title: Taiwan Strategic Partnership Announced
news.text: The company partnered with Taiwan's National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology to support autonomous system deployments with JUMP 20 platforms.

news.title: Space Force Awards Antenna Contract
news.text: AeroVironment secured a fixed-price contract option from the U.S. Space Force for two advanced antenna systems supporting the SCAR program.

news.title: HELMSSMAN IDIQ Awarded by U.S. Air Force
news.text: The Air Force awarded AeroVironment a 10-year HELMSSMAN IDIQ contract worth up to $499 million with two initial task orders totaling $246 million.

news.title: Golden Dome Deployment Expands at GrandSKY
news.text: AeroVironment broadened its GrandSKY collaboration to deploy Golden Dome counter-UAS capabilities in support of Project ULTRA.

news.title: HMIF Software Integrator Contract Secured
news.text: The U.S. Army selected AeroVironment as lead software and systems integrator for the HMIF Increment 1 program leveraging Kinesis mission software.

news.title: Korean Air Memorandum of Understanding
news.text: A memorandum with Korean Air made the carrier a priority partner to integrate JUMP 20 VTOL systems for Republic of Korea defense needs.

news.title: Freedom Eagle Missile Contract Announced
news.text: AeroVironment won a $95.9 million contract to deliver Freedom Eagle counter-UAS missiles, scaling production with key partners.

news.title: Mary Clum Named President of SCDE
news.text: The company appointed Mary Clum as President of the Space, Cyber & Directed Energy segment and elevated senior leadership across mission systems.
